errors.evidence: The description states the numerical range of the x-axis is from 0 to 40000. While the labeled ticks go up to 40000, the data and the axis itself extend beyond this to approximately 47000.
The description reports a data point at x=50000, but the x-axis in the figure does not extend to this value; it ends around 47000.
The description states that the loss value stabilizes around 0.25 at x=40000. However, the plot shows the value is much lower, very close to 0 and well under 0.1 at that point.
